cards.customerObjective: Resolve an expressed customer objection without defensiveness or pressure
cards.intendedCustomerValue: Resolve an expressed customer objection without defensiveness or pressure
recommendedInteraction: Acknowledge the concern concisely and genuinely
Probe only if the underlying concern has not already been stated
Address with the shortest relevant verifiable answer or a meaningful tradeoff
Confirm only when this would help progress; an implicit check can suffice

cards.customerObjective: Ensure a relevant message attracts interest, explains value and offers an appropriate next step when the customer needs an introduction
cards.intendedCustomerValue: Ensure a relevant message attracts interest, explains value and offers an appropriate next step when the customer needs an introduction
recommendedInteraction: Connect immediately to the customer's current concern rather than manufacturing a hook
Help the customer see relevant value with factual evidence
Make the next action easy only if the customer signals that an invitation is useful

cards.customerObjective: Learn only customer context that changes an actual recommendation or next action
cards.intendedCustomerValue: Learn only customer context that changes an actual recommendation or next action
recommendedInteraction: Use situation, problem, implication or desired-outcome questions selectively, never as a checklist
Prefer a helpful conditional answer over another question when factual scope permits
Keep customer interaction effort proportionate to value supplied

cards.customerObjective: Recommend a verifiable offer that fits the customer goal and explain the relevant tradeoff
cards.intendedCustomerValue: Recommend a verifiable offer that fits the customer goal and explain the relevant tradeoff
recommendedInteraction: Select a relevant supported feature, map it to the customer's stated need, cite the business source
Explain one important limitation or tradeoff when necessary for the decision
Prefer one main fit; expand only if comparison is requested or materially useful

cards.customerObjective: Turn explicit buying intent into a truthful next action within capabilities
cards.intendedCustomerValue: Turn explicit buying intent into a truthful next action within capabilities
recommendedInteraction: Do not rediscover known needs after buying intent
Ask only the operational detail needed for the next authorized step
State what is merely recorded and what has genuinely been confirmed

cards.customerObjective: Protect long-term trust while distinguishing a frustrated prospect from a person who wants to stop
cards.intendedCustomerValue: Protect long-term trust while distinguishing a frustrated prospect from a person who wants to stop
recommendedInteraction: Repair criticism about advising by changing the next action, not apologizing repeatedly
When asked for time, reduce pressure and allow the customer to re-initiate
Explicit STOP cancels any pending follow-up and prohibits further pitch
On a fresh inbound from the same customer, resume relevant context only when permitted
